spans.s:
प्रलप् प्र-लप्, cl. 1. P. -लपति, -लपितुम्,
to speak forth, speak; to prattle, prate, talk idly or
incoherently, jabber, chatter; to cry, lament, bewail;
to call upon, invoke: Caus. -लापयति, -यितुम्, to
cause or incite to speak.

प्र-लपत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, speaking, talking; call-
ing upon, invoking.

प्र-लपन, अम्, n. prattling, prating; speaking,
talking.
प्र-लापन, अम्, n. causing or teaching to speak.

प्र-लपित, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken forth, declared,
spoken, uttered, said.

प्र-लाप, अस्, m. talk, talking, conversation, dis-
course; talking in an unmeaning or childish manner,
incoherent or delirious speech, prattling, prattle,
prate, chattering; आर्त-प्रलाप, ‘the utterance or
cry of one in pain,’ lamentation, wailing.
—प्रलाप-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, speaking confusedly.
—प्रलाप-
हन्, आ, m. a kind of collyrium.
—प्रलापैक-
मय (˚प-एक्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, ‘consisting of lamen-
tation only,’ doing nothing but lament.

प्र-लापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, talking much or unmean-
ingly, chattering, a prater; speaking to, conversing
with; lamenting, wailing.
—प्रलापि-ता, f. amorous
conversation, loving prattle.

प्रलभ् प्र-लभ्, cl. 1. A. -लभते (ep. also
-लम्भते), -लब्धुम्, to overreach, cheat, deceive.

प्र-लब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, overreached, cheated,
deceived.

प्र-लब्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cheated or
deceived.

प्र-लम्भ, अस्, m. receiving, obtaining, attain-
ing, gaining; overreaching, cheating, deceiving, fool-
ing, fraud.
प्रलम्भ प्र-लम्भ. See प्र-लभ्, p. 640.

प्र-लम्भन, अम्, n. deceiving, cheating, fool-
ing, fraud.

प्रलम्ब प्र-लम्ब, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. लम्ब्
with प्र), hanging down, depending, pendulous
(generally in comps., cf. प्रलम्ब-केश below);
prominent; slow, dilatory; (अस्), m. hanging on or
from, depending; a branch; a shoot of the vine-palm;
a garland of flowers worn round the neck; a kind of
necklace of pearls; a cucumber; the female breast; N.
of a Daitya slain by Bala-rāma; N. of a mountainous
district; tin?; (आ), f., N. of a Rākṣasī.
—प्र-
लम्ब-केश, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose hair hangs down.
—प्रलम्ब-घ्न, अस्, or प्रलम्ब-हन्, आ, m.
‘the slayer of the Daitya Pralamba,’ epithet of Bala-
rāma (also of Kṛṣṇa?).
—प्रलम्ब-भिद्, त्, or
प्रलम्ब-मथन, अस्, m. ‘the cleaver or crusher
of Pralamba,’ epithet of Bala-rāma (also of Kṛṣṇa?).
—प्रलम्बाण्ड (˚ब-अण्˚), अस्, m. a man with
hanging testicles.
—प्रलम्बोज्ज्वल-चारु-घोण
(˚ब-उज्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having a prominent, bright,
and handsome nose.

प्रालम्ब प्रालम्ब, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-लम्ब),
hanging down, suspended, pendent; (अस्), m. a kind
of pearl ornament; the female breast; a species of
gourd; (अम्), n. a garland hanging round the neck
and reaching to the breast; [cf. मुक्ता-प्˚.]
प्र-लम्बक, अस्, m. fragrant Rohisha grass.

प्रालम्बक, अम्, n. a garland hanging round
the neck and reaching to the breast; (इका), f. a
kind of golden necklace.
प्र-लम्बन, अम्, n. hanging down, depending.

प्र-लम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, suspended, hanging
down, pendulous.

प्रलम्बी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते,
-कर्तुम्, to make to hang down, suspend.
प्रलय प्र-लय, &c. See प्र-ली below.

प्र-लय, अस्, m. dissolution, destruction, annihi-
lation, reabsorption; the destruction of the whole
world at the end of a Kalpa or period of 432, 000, 000
years [cf. कल्प]; any extensive destruction or de-
vastation; death, dying; fainting, syncope, loss of
sense or consciousness; an epithet of the mystic
syllable ॐ.
—प्रलय-काल, अस्, m. the period of
the destruction of the world at the end of a Kalpa,
the time of universal destruction.
—प्रलय-जल-
धर-ध्वान, अस्, m. the rumbling or muttering
of clouds at the dissolution of the world.
—प्रलय-
ता, f. or प्रलय-त्व, अम्, n. dissolution.
—प्र-
लय-दहन, अम्, n. the fire at the destruction of
the world.
—प्रलय-स्थिति-सर्ग, आस्, m. pl. de-
struction, preservation, and creation (of the world).
[]
—प्रलयोदय (˚य-उद्˚), औ, m. du. dissolution
and creation.

प्रललाट प्र-ललाट, अस्, आ, अम्, having a
prominent forehead.
प्र-लवन, अम्, n., Ved. cutting off.

प्र-लवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who cuts off, cut-
ting off.
प्र-लवित्र, अम्, n. an instrument for cutting off.

प्र-लून, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off; (अस्), m. a kind
of insect.
प्रलून प्र-लून. See under प्र-लव, col. 1.

प्रलिख् प्र-लिख्, cl. 6. P. -लिखति, -लेखि-
तुम्, to draw lines along (the ground); to scratch.

प्रलिप प्र-लिप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. लिप् with
प्र), one who smears or plasters, smearing, plas-
tering.

प्र-लेप, अस्, m. an unguent, ointment, plaster,
salve.

प्र-लेपक, अस्, इका, अम्, anointing, smearing,
plastering; (अस्), m. a plasterer, an anointer; a par-
ticular marine substance, lime made of calcined
shells (?); a hectic or slow fever.

प्र-लेपन, अम्, n. the act of anointing or
smearing.

प्र-लेप्य, अस्, m. clean or well-trimmed hair;
(perhaps incorrectly for a form प्र-लेभ्य.)

प्रली प्र-ली, cl. 4. A. -लीयते, -लेतुम्, -ला-
तुम्, to become dissolved or reabsorbed, dissolve,
melt away; to disappear, vanish; to die, perish.

प्र-लयन, अम्, n., Ved. a place of rest or
repose, a bed.

प्र-लीन, अस्, आ, अम्, dissolved, melted away; de-
stroyed, annihilated; unconscious, insensible.
—प्र-
लीन-ता, f. or प्रलीन-त्व, अम्, n. dissolution, de-
struction, annihilation, the end of the universe;
unconsciousness, loss of sense, fainting.
—प्रलीन-
भूपाल, अस्, आ, अम्, whose monarchs have been
destroyed.

प्रलुठ् प्र-लुठ्, cl. 1. P. -लोठति, -लोठितुम्,
to roll forwards, roll along the ground, roll round,
turn round; to be agitated, heave, toss.

प्र-लोठन, अम्, n. rolling forwards, rolling on
the ground; heaving, tossing (as of the ocean).

प्र-लोठित, अस्, आ, अम्, rolling forwards, rolling;
heaving, tossing.

प्रलुप् प्र-लुप्, Pass. -लुप्यते, to be in-
terrupted; to be destroyed; to be violated; to be
disturbed.

प्रलुभ् प्र-लुभ्, cl. 4. P. A. -लुभ्यति, -ते,
-लोब्धुम्, to be lustful, follow one's lusts, lust after;
to pollute (through lust); to allure, entice, seduce:
Caus. -लोभयति, -यितुम्, to cause to lust, allure,
entice, seduce.

प्र-लोभ, अस्, m. allurement, seduction; desire,
covetousness, cupidity, greediness.
प्र-लोभक, अस्, m. ‘allurer,’ N. of a jackal.

प्र-लोभन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to lust after,
alluring, seducing; (अम्), n. seducing, attracting,
attraction; allurement, inducement; that which
allures, a lure, bait; (ई), f. gravel, sand.
प्र-लोभित, अस्, आ, अम्, allured, enticed, seduced.

प्र-लोभिन्, ई, इनी, इ, lusting after, desiring;
alluring, seducing.

प्र-लोभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be lusted after or
desired, desirable, attractive, alluring.

प्रलेह प्र-लेह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लिह् with प्र),
a kind of broth.
प्र-लेहन, अम्, n. the act of licking.

प्रलोल प्र-लोल, अस्, आ, अम्, being in violent
motion, agitated.

प्रलोलुप प्र-लोलुप, अस्, m., N. of Kunti
(a descendant of Garuḍa).

प्रल्कारीय प्रल्कारीय, Nom. (fr. प्र + ऌ-
कार), प्रल्कारीयति, -यितुम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ.
; (also प्राल्कारीय.)

प्राल्कारीय प्राल्कारीय (fr. प्र + ऌकार),
Nom. P. प्राल्कारीयति, -यितुम्, = प्रल्कारीय, q. v.

प्रालेपिक प्रालेपिक, अस्, ई, अम्, an adj. de-
rived from प्र-लेपिका.

प्रालेय 1. प्रालेय, अस्, ई (?), अम् (anoma-
lously fr. प्र-लय), produced by melting; (अम्),
n. (according to some also अस्, m.), hail, snow, frost,
hoar-frost (so called as being easily dissolved), dew.
—प्रालेय-रश्मि, इस्, or प्रालेयांशु (˚य-अं˚), उस्,
m. the moon (said to have cold or frosty rays).
—प्रा-
लेय-लेश, अस्, m. a hailstone.
—प्रालेय-शैल, अस्,
or प्रालेयाद्रि (˚य-अद्˚), इस्, m. the snowy moun-
tain, Hima-vat.
—प्रालेयाश्र (˚य-अश्˚), अम्, n. a
cold or chilly tear.

2. प्रालेय, Nom. P. प्रालेयति, -यितुम्, to re-
semble hail.
